description: Read weekly distinct optimization-event delivery counts by ad set, campaign or platform from stored data. Plainrouter delivery counts, not Meta's learning status. Test sends excluded; conversion kinds separate. Configurable planning benchmark, unverified live. No provider calls or writes.

from.description: Inclusive event occurrence beginning; defaults to 90 days before to.

model.description: One integer assignment. Default campaign/ad-set membership is the last pre-conversion touch carrying a campaign/ad-set id, not the literal last site touch. First selects the first qualifying touch.

to.description: Inclusive event occurrence end; defaults to now. Weeks use UTC occurrence time.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_event_volume
title: Get weekly event volume
